profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
As a Software Engineer at Microsoft, I am part of the CoreOS team, specializing in kernel development. My work focuses on Container Manager—a cutting-edge virtualization platform for Windows containers. As the main developer for Windows Sandbox and a part of the Container Manager team, I have gained extensive experience in both the windows virtualization stack and user-facing technology.

I ensure that Windows Sandbox provides a seamless and efficient user experience, leveraging my expertise in both operating systems engineering and user interface design.
